posts.title: Terminology beyond the NixOS Trademark
posts.description: A quick one. NixOS recently got a trademark. Awesome. Now what. As a governance insider, I’ll give you a general gist of what this likely means: Using the word “NixOs” for products generally wont be permitted. “Nix” can be used in some cases, albeit only when there is no confusion or product conflict with official NixOS foundation projects. posts.title: The AI bioweapon risk isn't jailbreaks
posts.description: What a Danish threat assessment gets right about AI I read Det biologiske trusselsbillede 2026 , published this summer by the Centre for Biosecurity and Biopreparedness (CBB) at Statens Serum Institut. It’s the first update since 2020 to Denmark’s national assessment of man-made biological threats, and on artificial intelligence I think it brings a more holistic perspective than is typically seen
